package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/yaklang/yaklang/common/bin-parser/parser/stream_parser"
)

type input struct {
	Sourcecase string `json:"sourcecase"`
	Path       string `json:"input_path"`
	Offset     int64  `json:"byte_offset"`
	Length     int    `json:"byte_length"`
	RawSHA     string `json:"rawSHA"`
	Budget     int    `json:"budget"`
	Depth      int    `json:"depth_limit"`
}

func main() {
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 4096), 1<<20)
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		var in input
		if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &in); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		data, err := os.ReadFile(in.Path)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if in.Offset < 0 || in.Length < 0 || in.Offset > int64(len(data)) || int64(in.Length) > int64(len(data))-in.Offset || in.Depth != 8 {
			panic("source input boundary/depth differs")
		}
		raw := data[in.Offset : in.Offset+int64(in.Length)]
		rawSHA := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(raw))
		if rawSHA != in.RawSHA {
			panic("source payload differs")
		}
		fields, decodeErr := stream_parser.DecodeGTPv2Wire(raw, in.Budget)
		message := ""
		if decodeErr != nil {
			message = decodeErr.Error()
		}
		row := map[string]any{"sourcecase": in.Sourcecase, "rawSHA": rawSHA, "budget": in.Budget, "fields": fields, "error": message, "is_context": errors.Is(decodeErr, stream_parser.ErrObservedWireContext), "is_budget": errors.Is(decodeErr, stream_parser.ErrObservedWireBudget), "is_format": errors.Is(decodeErr, stream_parser.ErrGTPv2WireFormat)}
		if err := encoder.Encode(row); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
	if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
